patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.chiefComplaint: Small cut on my leg, terrible pain
clinical.quoteLong: It's just a scratch from the garden, I know it looks like nothing. But it hurts so much I couldn't sleep, and I feel like I'm dying. Something is really wrong.
clinical.presentationShort: 58yo F, diabetic — 36h after a minor leg scratch, agonising pain with an unimpressive wound. Systemically unwell.
clinical.presentationLong: 58-year-old diabetic female, thirty-six hours after a minor leg scratch, with agonising pain far beyond the appearance of the wound and looking systemically unwell.

diagnosis.disposition: Resus → sepsis pathway, broad-spectrum antibiotics, immediate surgical review for debridement
diagnosis.why: The wound is a decoy. Pain out of proportion, systemic toxicity, and an infection that is moving means surgery NOW — antibiotics alone will not save this limb or this patient.
diagnosis.redFlag: Pain grossly out of proportion to a benign-looking wound, with septic physiology — necrotising fasciitis.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a hispanic 58-year-old woman in a housecoat with one trouser leg rolled up, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting back heavily, the affected leg extended and held very still, hands gripping the chair arms
signs: a small unimpressive scratch on the shin with a dusky purplish tinge spreading around it
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: systemically very unwell despite a minor-looking wound
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a hispanic 58-year-old woman in a housecoat with one trouser leg rolled up, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting back heavily, the affected leg extended and held very still, hands gripping the chair arms. Expression: ashen, frightened and exhausted. Clearly visible: a small unimpressive scratch on the shin with a dusky purplish tinge spreading around it; grey clammy skin; sweat across the forehead. Overall: systemically very unwell despite a minor-looking wound. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
